gate: Exploratory learning gate: every seed base-power cell has positive Bonferroni-adjusted approximate bootstrap lower confidence bound and cutoff-aware point improvement at least 0.05; no seed/opponent cell has an upper bound below zero; every final cell cutoff rate <=0.05. No detected regression is not evidence of noninferiority. Also report rigorous bounded Hoeffding intervals separately; they do not silently replace the declared exploratory gate.
statistics_scope: Resample 512 team/mechanics clusters, keeping both seat orientations and initial/final outcomes together. Unknown cutoff rewards range [0,1]; bootstrap lower/upper endpoint means separately using the same resamples. Approximate percentile coverage, not a finite-sample certificate. The same development panel is reused across seeds/opponents; cell agreement is not independent team-level replication.
budget: 12288 train games plus 18432 development evaluation games. Final checkpoint only; no checkpoint, seed or opponent selection, optional stopping, resampling, or budget expansion.
data: Official R7 train/development partitions via unchanged F2 admission. Fresh development namespace seed8422026. No final reserved-data decoding. Ordered whole-team split is not species/family disjointness.
model: Unchanged F1 928 features, 64 hidden units, 14 actions, bounded sigmoid value. Random initialization per seed; no warm start from F2. No curriculum or opponent-mixture change.
recovery: Atomic model/Adam/cohort-evidence checkpoint after every complete eight-game cohort. Exact seeded replay of uncommitted work only on explicit resume; never stitch durations or skip failed games.
